content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card is the standard eyebrow–headline–two buttons stack with the photo pushed to the bottom of the first screen, and the three product cards below are tall, photo-less boxes with the same branch icon repeated.","desktopNote":"The scale runs wild below the hero: the hours heading, the phone number and the footer brand name are all poster-sized, the hours band ends in a dead cream strip and the product cards are mostly empty space around an icon and a price.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":2,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Give the three products real photos (or one shared product shot) and shrink the cards so icon, name and price sit together instead of floating in a tall empty box.","Tame the type scale: footer brand name and phone number should be one step above body, and the hours heading should not outweigh the hero headline; remove the duplicated small company name under the giant one.","Fix the hours section on desktop by aligning heading and table to one baseline and removing the empty cream band beneath; let the hero photo also peek higher on phone so the first screen isn't only a card."],"blockers":[]}
